Scoring 3 Trace Rifle hits against enemies affected by a matching Elemental debuff grants increased Trace Rifle damage for 4 seconds:
• Legendary Trace Rifles: 50%
• Exotic Special Trace Rifles and <exotic Lodestar />: 35%

<exotic Microcosm /> deals 20% increased damage after scoring 4 hits against enemies affected by any Elemental debuff.

Matching debuffs by element:
• <arc Arc />: <arc Blind />, <arc Jolt />
• <solar Solar />: <solar Scorch />, <solar Ignition />
• <void Void />: <void Suppression />, <void Volatile />, <void Weaken />
• <stasis Stasis />: <stasis Slow />, <stasis Freeze />, <stasis Shatter />
• <strand Strand />: <strand Sever />, <strand Suspend />, <strand Unravel />

source.text:
Upon scoring 3 Trace Rifle hits against enemies affected by Element-Matching Debuffs:
Grants increased Trace Rifle damage for 4 seconds.

Legendary Trace Rifles = 50% increased damage
Exotic Special Traces / Lodestar = 35% increased damage

Microcosm deals 20% increased damage after scoring 4 hits against enemies affected by ANY Elemental Debuff.

Arc = ↓Blind ↓Jolt
Solar = ↓Scorch ↓Ignition
Void = ↓Suppression ↓Volatile ↓Weaken
Stasis = ↓Slow ↓Freeze ↓Shatter
Strand = ↓Sever ↓Suspend ↓Unravel
